title: Rural Voices in Education
author: Maria Coady
description: Rural Voices in Education is a space for conversation with national and local leaders, students, families, educators, and community members. We explore the stories, strengths, challenges, and possibilities that are shaping bilingual and multilingual education in rural places.

title: The Teen Wellbeing Lab
author: The Teen Wellbeing Lab
description:
Today’s teens face unprecedented pressure—from 24/7 social media to relentless academic and athletic demands. It’s no wonder many feel overwhelmed and disconnected. But we believe the truth is simple: teenagers don’t need to be "fixed." They need to be equipped.
Your hosts Carlotta Martinus and Jo Mountford provide evidence-informed tools to help teenagers step out of their heads, into their bodies, and back into a place of personal safety.
In each episode, we dive deep into the specific challenges defining the modern teenage experience. Let's help you thrive.

title: The CRO Playbook
author: RiskSmart
description:
The CRO Series brings experienced Chief Risk Officers for candid conversations on the issues shaping business and risk management today.
We explore what really happens in boardrooms, and key decision-making forums. From emerging risks and strategic challenges to governance, culture, and leadership, each episode uncovers the priorities, pressures, and opportunities facing risk professionals today.
Whether you're a risk practitioner, business leader, or simply interested in how organisations navigate uncertainty, this series offers an inside look at modern risk management from those involved.

title: The Enemy in the Chart: Advanced Technical Curriculum
author: Thomas Rooney & Muscle Trading Ltd.
description: A 9-episode cinematic masterclass in high-finance technical execution and human behavioral psychology. Created and hosted by Thomas Rooney, founder of Muscle Trading Ltd., 'The Enemy in the Chart' bridges 25 years of athletic discipline, 10 years of stage performance discipline with 16 years of institutional-grade risk management. From debunking retail market myths and mastering candlestick order flow to executing trailing stops, the Power Hour method, VWAP dynamic entries, and biological cognitive resilience, this curriculum delivers a battle-tested blueprint for sovereign operators.

title: Cardiology Course FM
author: Dr. A M Thirugnanam, MD, MSICP, FSCAI, Ph.D.
description: A 45-minute cardiology masterclass for doctors, students, residents, fellows and nurses. Senior Interventional Cardiologist Dr. A M Thirugnanam, MD, MSICP, FSCAI, Ph.D., founder of the Academy of Elite Doctors, joins host Alexander Wood to cover ECG and echo, arrhythmias, pacing and CRT, coronary disease, cardiogenic shock, heart failure, valvular and congenital disease, endocarditis, hypertension, heart disease in pregnancy, cath lab complications, ethics and exam preparation. Each episode reviews current guidelines and landmark trials and closes with real clinical cases.

title: Spotlight Support: Behind the Scenes
author: Jamie-Lee Meneely
description: Honest conversations about what really goes on behind the scenes in the dance and performing arts world, with mental health and wellbeing at the heart of it. From pressure, confidence and comparison to burnout, rejection and expectations, we'll talk about the things that affect us but aren't always said out loud. I'll share my own experiences alongside conversations with people across the industry. title: Healthy Discussion
author: Dude
description: We discuss important health topics, healthy eating, physical fitness, mental well-being, disease prevention, and everyday habits that support a better lifestyle.Through simple explanations and practical tips, this podcast aims to make health information easy to understand and apply in daily life. Whether you want to improve your nutrition, stay active, manage stress, or learn more about maintaining your well-being, My Healthy Discussion provides useful insights to guide you.Join us as we explore ways to build healthier habits, make informed health decisions, and inspire positive changes for ourselves, our families, and our communities.My Healthy Discussion — Your health, your knowledge, your better future!

title: The Bath Fitter Fam Podcast
author: Bath Fitter
description:
The Bath Fitter Fam Podcast gives homeowners straightforward answers to the questions that come up before, during, and after a bathroom remodel.


Each episode breaks down topics like bathroom remodeling costs, shower and tub replacement, materials, installation, warranties, design decisions, financing, and what homeowners should know before choosing a contractor.


Hosted by members of the Bath Fitter Fam, the show brings real experience from inside the home improvement industry to help you understand your options, avoid surprises, and make more confident decisions about your bathroom project.


No confusing sales talk. Just practical conversations, honest answers, and helpful information for homeowners.


New episodes feature Bath Fitter team members, industry experts, manufacturers, installers, and homeowners sharing what actually goes into creating a better bathroom.

author: Sanyra Zeeshan
description: Beyond Your Control is a faith and growth podcast about navigating the things life puts beyond our control. Through candid conversations with people who have faced real tests and trials, we explore faith, resilience, relationships, temptations, and the pursuit of a meaningful life, remembering that this dunya is temporary, and what truly matters is how we choose to live through it.

description:
DECLASSIFIED — Investigative Documentary Channel
The stories they buried. The events they classified. The truth they hoped you'd never find.
DECLASSIFIED uncovers the world's most suppressed histories — nuclear disasters, government cover-ups, Cold War secrets, unsolved murders, CIA operations, and geopolitical conspiracies that shaped the world we live in today.
Every episode is researched, fact-checked, and told with raw honesty. No opinion. No agenda. Just the truth — declassified.
📌 NEW EPISODES EVERY WEEK
This is not mainstream media.
This is not entertainment.

description:

Read along and save new words at studybrew.co

author: Bria Gadd - Integrative Nutrition Coach, Hormone Specialist, Personal Trainer, Perimenopause Coach,
description: In the 35-55 age box and starting to wonder if you will ever feel like you again? Weight gain, night wakings, brain fog, hot flashes, headaches, cravings, bloating, joint pain, mood swings, anxiety are all on the rise and no matter what you try, nothing moves the needle. Your host, Bria Gadd is a Functional Diagnostic Nutrition® Practitioner, Certified Holistic Health Coach, and Personal Trainer who specializes in female hormones. After helping thousands of women lose weight in their 20’s and 30’s, Bria recognized a difficult shift in women’s ability to get results in their body during their perimenopause years. Including her own frustrating 15lb weight gain amidst daily intense workouts and the demands of midlife. Tune in twice a week on Mondays and Thursdays to the top-ranked Period Whisperer Podcast for solo episodes and interviews with real life women and industry experts designed to help you understand the truth about perimenopause, take immediate action on the most important strategies for reducing inflammation and optimizing hormones, and get you in a body that releases weight easily. Whether you’re just starting to question if perimenopause is behind how you are feeling, are in the depths of hormonal chaos, or just want to learn how to feel your best through menopause and beyond, you’re in the right place. If you’re ready to decode the whispers of your body and heal your hormones so you can thrive again, listen to our fan favorite Episode 129: The 3 Nutrition Phases That Will Help You Release Belly Fat Every Time In Perimenopause

title: The Dream Chasers Podcast
author: Uta Schmidt
description: Hosted by author and speaker Uta Schmidt, this podcast explores what it really costs to pursue a dream. Each episode features honest conversations with authors, speakers, and everyday people about heartbreak, setbacks, trauma, healing, faith, and personal growth. The debut season opens with a rare two-part interview with Wm. Paul Young, #1 New York Times bestselling author of The Shack, recorded a decade apart. Real stories. Real struggles. Real transformation. This is for listeners disillusioned with surface-level answers and performance-driven faith, and ready for candid discussions.

title: A Train of Thought with Matt Harrington
author: Matt Harrington
description:
A Train of Thought with Matt Harrington explores what happens when behavior analysis meets business, marketing, leadership, and growth.


Hosted by Matthew Harrington, BCBA, a behavioral health growth strategist with experience in clinical leadership and ABA marketing, the show goes beyond theory to explore the ideas, decisions, and strategies shaping the future of behavioral health.


Each episode features candid conversations with founders, clinicians, executives, and industry leaders about growing organizations, building stronger teams, reaching more families, navigating change, and creating meaningful impact.

From ABA and behavioral science to marketing, entrepreneurship, leadership, and innovation, Matt brings a behavior analyst’s perspective to the challenges that leaders face every day.


Whether you’re a BCBA, practice owner, healthcare leader, marketer, or simply interested in how behavior influences business, A Train of Thought offers practical insights, fresh perspectives, and conversations worth thinking about.

title: The Menopause Sense Check with Frances Bellamy
author: Frances Bellamy
description: Frances Bellamy makes sense of perimenopause, menopause, and life afterward through clear conversations about symptoms, options, evidence, and questions to bring to a clinician. Produced by Edenroot Studios. Educational content, not individual medical advice.

title: Three Girl Chums at Laurel Hall (The Mystery of the School by the Lake)
author: May Hollis Barton
description:
Maggie, June, and Ruth stumble upon a series of perplexing incidents at Laurel Hall that challenge their friendship and courage. When strange occurrences disrupt their idyllic boarding school life by the lake, the trio finds themselves in the midst of a thrilling mystery. As they uncover clues and navigate the challenges posed by the school's elite mean girls, they must rely on their wits and teamwork to solve the puzzles around them.

This engaging adventure follows the girls as they learn new sports, forge friendships, and confront the trials of growing up in a competitive environment. Each mystery they encounter not only tests their problem-solving skills but also deepens their bond, proving that true friendship can overcome any obstacle. Whether it's a missing trophy or whispers of secret passageways, the mysteries at Laurel Hall keep listeners on the edge of their seats.

Join Maggie, June, and Ruth on their unforgettable journey filled with excitement, laughter, and life lessons. Will they unravel the secrets lurking in the school? Discover the adventures that await as these three girl chums prove that courage and camaraderie can light the way through any challenge. Perfect for young listeners and nostalgic adults alike, this audiobook invites you into a world of adventure and intrigue that echoes across generations.

description:
Welcome to MRD — MR. Dark Trace, where every shadow hides a story and every trace may lead to the truth.
This channel explores the darkest side of reality through true crime, unsolved mysteries, disturbing cases, missing persons, mysterious disappearances, criminal investigations, and chilling real-life stories.
At MRD, we go beyond the headlines. We examine the details, timelines, evidence, motives, suspects, unanswered questions, and strange circumstances surrounding each case. Some stories have clear answers. Others remain buried in uncertainty, leaving behind traces that may never be fully explained.
With a dark, atmospheric, and suspenseful storytelling style, MR. Dark Trace takes you into the cases that continue to haunt investigators, families, and communities long after the headlines disappear.

From iconic chefs and winemakers to emerging producers and artisans, Great Scotts celebrates the people, the craft and the connections that make great food and wine possible. author: Podlatino
description: One War, Many Perspectives: 1939–1945 reconstructs the Second World War through the countries that shaped, resisted, or transformed the conflict. Each episode adopts the perspective of one nation, exploring how its war began, the decisions its leaders made, the ideologies that influenced society, how civilians and soldiers experienced events, and what followed from victory, defeat, occupation, or resistance. From Nazi Germany and invaded Poland to China, Japan, the Soviet Union, the United States, and British-ruled India, the series connects events that occurred simultaneously but were understood in radically different ways. Combining historical storytelling with a documentary approach, the podcast examines alliances, propaganda, military campaigns, political choices, and everyday life without reducing history to a list of battles and dates. Designed for a general audience, the series offers listeners a clearer understanding of 1939–1945 through multiple national experiences while remaining grounded in documented facts and the immense human cost of the war.

Through the Root, Release & Rise framework, I walk women through a simple but powerful process of coming back to themselves, releasing what no longer fits, and rising boldly into who they are meant to be. Whether you're a woman over 30 reinventing yourself, navigating midlife, or simply ready to stop waiting and start moving, this podcast was made for you.
This podcast covers topics such as: 
How do I stop people pleasing and start setting boundaries? 
How do I build confidence as a woman over 30? 
How do I find my purpose when I feel lost? 
How do I practice gratitude when life feels hard? 
How do I overcome negative self-talk and start loving myself?

title: Comparative Law Insights in  Court
author: BARR LAWSON
description:
Comparative Law Insights: Court Proceedings in Nigeria and the United Kingdom

A clear and engaging comparison of how court systems and legal proceedings work in Nigeria and the United Kingdom  from court hierarchy and criminal trials to civil litigation, juries, and legal pluralism.
 we take a detailed look at the court systems and actual court proceedings of two jurisdictions linked by a shared common-law heritage: Nigeria and the United Kingdom.
We begin by mapping the hierarchy of courts in each country  from Nigeria’s Supreme Court, Court of Appeal, Federal and State High Courts, down to Magistrate, Customary and Sharia courts, and from the UK Supreme Court through the Court of Appeal, High Court, Crown Court, County Court and Magistrates’ Courts.
We then walk through a typical criminal case in both systems, examining investigation, arraignment, trial procedure, the role of the judge versus the jury, standards of proof, sentencing and appeals. The same careful comparison is made for civil proceedings, covering how cases are commenced, the use of front-loading in Nigeria, case management tracks in England and Wales, evidence, judgment and enforcement.
Along the way we highlight the major points of contrast  legal pluralism in Nigeria, the continued use of juries in England and Wales, the structure of the legal profession, and the impact of federalism  while also noting the deep underlying similarities that still connect the two systems.
Whether you are a law student, a legal practitioner handling cross-border matters, or simply curious about how legal institutions evolve, this episode offers a clear, structured and practical overview of court proceedings in Nigeria and the United Kingdom.

Hosts David Walker and Mitchell Turner bring two very different backgrounds. David is a residential home builder in Western North Carolina with a career spanning farming, consulting, and corporate intelligence work. Mitchell is a 25-year tech veteran who lost his job to AI and now helps people build with it.

Each episode starts with a real business problem and walks through how they actually solved it: what worked, what failed, and what they'd do differently. Topics include standard operating procedures, meeting and call recording, automated daily briefings, AI agents and guardrails, and the human side of change, including the question of whether you should be afraid.

author: Dr. Sam Weah Monboe
description:
Welcome to This Too Is America, a thought-provoking documentary and civic education podcast created and hosted by Dr. Sam Weah Monboe and produced by Sam Monboe Studio Radio in Charlotte, North Carolina, where we create tomorrow's media today.

This podcast explores the ideas, institutions, challenges, and opportunities that shape the American experience. Through documentary storytelling, historical analysis, civic education, public affairs discussions, and thoughtful commentary, This Too Is America seeks to inform, inspire, and empower citizens to become active participants in building a stronger nation.

At a time when misinformation, division, and political polarization often dominate public discourse, this podcast provides listeners with an opportunity to examine issues through the lens of facts, critical thinking, leadership, accountability, and national unity. Each series is designed to encourage thoughtful dialogue while helping Americans better understand the responsibilities that come with citizenship.

Topics include:

• Presidential leadership and elections

• Civic responsibility and democratic participation

• American history and government

• Public policy and national issues

• Character and leadership in public life

• Community development and national unity

• Education and civic awareness

• Future challenges facing the United States

• Lessons for future generations

Featured documentary series include Why Should We Trust You With America?, a comprehensive voter education project designed to help citizens evaluate presidential candidates based on character, integrity, transparency, service, judgment, and leadership rather than personality, popularity, or political marketing.

The mission of This Too Is America is simple:

To educate citizens, strengthen democracy, encourage unity, promote informed decision-making, and help prepare future generations to become responsible stewards of the American experiment.

Because America is more than politics.

More than elections.

More than headlines.

America is its people.

Its principles.

Its responsibilities.

Its future.

And every citizen has a role to play in preserving and strengthening it.

Join Dr. Sam Weah Monboe as we explore the stories, questions, challenges, and opportunities that continue to define our nation.

This Too Is America.

Sam Monboe Studio Radio.

Where we create tomorrow's media today.

Opera is a living tradition. For generations, vocal nuances and master secrets were passed down only through word of mouth or worn sheet music. But with the invention of the gramophone, history shifted: the composer's true intent was captured in wax, vinyl, and digital tracks. Join us as we uncover timeless musical choices, shifting audience tastes, and the fascinating evolution of the operatic voice. title: Dr. G. Wayne Jackson Jr Lessons in the key of life

description:
Lessons in the Key of Life is a reflective, transformative podcast for people who are done surviving and ready to live with clarity, integrity, and depth.

Hosted by Dr. G. Wayne Jackson, the show explores the real terrain of being human through honest conversation, lived experience, spiritual insight, and practical wisdom. Each episode invites listeners to slow down, tell the truth about their inner world, and uncover the lessons life leaves behind, especially in seasons of loss, uncertainty, and transition.


This is not a podcast about fixing yourself.
It’s about revealing what was always there.


Life has a way of unraveling us. Sometimes it does it gently. Sometimes it does it all at once. There are moments when simply getting out of bed, brushing your teeth, or choosing not to give up becomes the quietest form of resilience. In those moments, life is still speaking. The question is whether we’re willing to listen.


Lessons in the Key of Life is for those willing to sort through the mess, not to shame themselves, but to find meaning, wisdom, and forward movement. It’s about learning that what happens to you is not the final story. How you respond is.


Blending storytelling with grounded reflection and actionable insight, this podcast supports deep self-awareness, emotional maturity, and intentional growth. You’ll find conversations about boundaries, identity, healing, resilience, purpose, and the courage it takes to become whole.

If you believe growth is an active process, that self-honesty matters, and that transformation begins with responsibility rather than perfection, you’re in the right place.


This is a space for people who want more than motivation.
It’s a space for those ready to live aligned, awake, and whole.

title: Built for Chaos
author: Bryan Weatherby
description: BUILT FOR CHAOS — hosted by Bryan Weatherby. Twenty-one years in the U.S. Army. A decade leading in chemical plants. Now running damn near a whole industrial gas plant — and rebuilding everything in real time: career, credit, brand, retirement. This show is three things at once: a leadership masterclass from two decades in uniform and the plant floor, an honest diary of a man rebuilding with no filter, and a microphone for veterans — a platform for vets to be heard, share their stories, and use as a resource. description:
The Balanced Home with Carolina is a podcast about creating a home that supports the life you want to live.


Hosted by Carolina Barreto, founder of In Style Home Organizing, a professional home organizing company based in Northern New Jersey, this podcast goes beyond decluttering and organizing tips to explore how our homes influence our routines, productivity, relationships, and overall well-being.


Through honest conversations, practical advice, expert interviews, and behind-the-scenes stories from real organizing projects, Carolina shares how to create spaces that are functional, beautiful, and easy to maintain.

Whether you're a busy parent, a working professional, or simply someone who wants to feel more at ease at home, you'll discover how thoughtful organization can help you spend less time managing your belongings and more time enjoying your life.

Because your home doesn't have to be perfect. It just needs to work for you and the people you love.

title: Rotten Mango
author: Rotten Mango
description:
Rotten Mango Pod 🍒 | True Crime & Dark Stories

Welcome to Rotten Mango Pod, where we dive deep into the darkest, strangest, and most shocking stories from around the world. From chilling true crime cases and mysterious disappearances to disturbing criminal investigations and unbelievable real-life events, every episode explores the stories that leave people questioning what they thought they knew.

Discover the hidden details, unexpected twists, psychological motives, and shocking truths behind some of the most fascinating cases ever reported. If you love true crime, unsolved mysteries, criminal psychology, and dark storytelling, this podcast is for you.

Welcome to The Girls Are Talking - where five women with five different perspectives discuss hot topics, and absolutely nothing is off limits.
From love, dating and relationships to money, friendships, pop culture and all the messy bits in between, expect strong opinions, hilarious moments and honest conversations.
Meet the girls: pop culture  icon Keisha Buchanan, Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter Kamille, comedian extraordinaire Sharifa Butterfly, author and content creator Tara Thorpe and radio presenter Issra Wiheba.
Expect laughs. Expect disagreements. Expect honesty. And most importantly… expect the girls to TALK.

Cocoa Beach Eco Tours runs dolphin, manatee and wildlife boat tours on the Banana River Lagoon, departing daily from 333 W Cocoa Beach Causeway in Cocoa Beach. The 2.5 hour eco tour cruises the mangrove backwaters of the Thousand Islands on a shaded pontoon, where resident bottlenose dolphins, manatees, rays, herons and ospreys are part of daily life on the water. Local captains narrate the ecology of the Indian River Lagoon and keep the boat quiet so wildlife is never crowded. Sunset cruises run about 1.5 hours, and on select dates the boat cruises for an open water view of launches from Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral. Up to 36 guests, all ages, bathroom on board, free parking.

title: Stuck is Where it Starts
author: Anne Wilkinson
description:
You know something needs to change. You’ve thought about it, talked it through with family and friends, and promised yourself you’ll do it a hundred times.
Yet you're still going round in circles, procrastinating, and probably being hard on yourself.
But what if there’s more to this, and it’s not your fault?
I created Stuck Is Where It Starts to explore why we get stuck, what keeps us there, and how to get unstuck. Questions like: Why can’t I do what I say I’m going to do? Why does thinking harder rarely help? Why do I hold myself back? And much more.
I’m Anne Wilkinson, an executive leadership, business and career coach. Every topic is drawn from 25 years real coaching experience, working with hundreds of client; business leaders, career changers, solopreneurs, coaches and creatives. 
So the chances are you’ll see yourself here.
Expect short solo episodes of around five minutes, with stories, nuggets of wisdom and practical tips.

Each episode separates documented facts from claims, examines competing explanations, and identifies what remains unknown. Explore the sources and case files at evidentiarypodcast.com. New episodes Mondays.

✨ Welcome to Lantern & Lullaby — immersive sleep stories designed to help you relax, unwind and drift peacefully into sleep.

title: The Stainless Steel Rat (Adventures of Slippery Jim)
author: Harry Harrison
description:
Slippery Jim deGriz, a master con man and thief, has outsmarted every police force across the galaxy. But when he clashes with the relentless Special Corps, he faces his most formidable challenge yet. In Harry Harrison's captivating science fiction classic, "Stainless Steel Rat," Jim’s life of crime takes an unexpected turn as he discovers that survival means more than just staying one step ahead of the law.

As Jim navigates a universe filled with danger and deceit, he must confront his own morality and redefine what it means to be a criminal. The stakes rise as he uncovers a plot that could threaten the very fabric of existence itself. This thrilling adventure weaves humor, action, and sharp wit, making it a standout in the genre.

Listeners will be drawn into Jim's wild escapades as he juggles loyalty, betrayal, and the quest for redemption. Can a criminal mastermind become a hero? What sacrifices will he make to save a universe that has always been his playground? With each twist and turn, this audiobook pulls you deeper into a world where the line between right and wrong blurs, leaving you questioning everything you thought you knew about justice. Get ready for a ride like no other—because in the universe of the Stainless Steel Rat, nothing is ever as it seems.

Welcome to The HealthLens Podcast — your trusted source for medical insights, health and wellness tips, and practical health education. title: The People of the Crater (A Classic Lost World Adventure)

description:
Captain Garin, once the top fighter pilot of the American forces, now faces a stark new reality: poverty and hunger in a post-war world. When a mysterious expedition to Antarctica offers him a chance to escape his bleak existence, he jumps at the opportunity. But as he delves into the heart of the Antarctic mist, he discovers it hides much more than icy winds and snow. Strange creatures beckon him, drawing him into a conflict that feels both alien and ancient. Garin's journey unfolds in a realm where the mist conceals dark secrets and the threat of the Caves of Darkness looms ever larger.

As Garin navigates this treacherous landscape, he must confront not only external foes but also the shadows of his own past. What starts as a quest for survival quickly spirals into a battle against forces that seek to enslave or destroy him. With the fate of humanity hanging in the balance, Garin learns that some missions are written in the stars.

Join him on this thrilling adventure filled with unexpected alliances, ancient prophecies, and the fight against a sinister power. 'People of the Crater' invites listeners into a gripping tale of courage, mystery, and the relentless pursuit of hope. Will Garin conquer the Black Throne, or will he be consumed by the darkness? Tune in to uncover the secrets that lie beneath the mist.

title: Broken Beyond Repair | Weekly Talks Podcast

Broken Beyond Repair is my honest, unfiltered conversation about life after losing my 23-year-old son, Kody, on February 18, 2025.
I talk about child loss, traumatic grief, motherhood, faith, heaven, and trusting God when nothing makes sense. These are not polished conversations or easy answers. They're the real questions, pain, and everyday moments of learning to live in a world that will never be the same.
I'm broken beyond what I can repair, but still held by God.

We then explore each section in depth, examining the Mishnayos and their commentaries while continually connecting the details to the broader structure. The goal is not simply to understand each Mishna individually, but to appreciate where it fits, how the Mesechta develops and ultimately forms a unified whole.

title: Anything You Can Do... (A Battle Against the Unknown)

The sudden crash of an alien ship sets off a decade-long nightmare for humanity. The Nipe, a terrifying extraterrestrial creature, stalks the shadows of Earth, leaving a trail of fear and bodies in its wake. It hunts humans for food, stealing materials to fuel its mysterious agenda, while government officials scramble to contain the threat. But hope emerges in the form of Bart Stanton, a superman engineered with cutting-edge medical science, created specifically to confront this deadly menace.

As Stanton prepares to face the Nipe, he must navigate the complexities of his own identity and the expectations placed upon him. This gripping tale explores the conflict between humanity's resilience and the unknown forces that threaten its existence. Listeners will be drawn into a world where the line between predator and prey blurs, and the fate of Earth hangs in the balance.

What secrets does the Nipe hold, and what will Stanton discover about himself in this high-stakes battle? Join the journey through suspense, mystery, and the unyielding struggle for survival in Randall Garrett's riveting science fiction thriller, "Anything You Can Do..." Prepare to be on the edge of your seat as each twist and turn reveals more about this alien terror and the hero destined to confront it.

author: Favour & Anita
description:
Who are you beyond the titles you carry, the roles you play, and the expectations the world places on you?

Welcome to MANY SIDES OF HER, a podcast hosted by Favour and Anita, where we have bold, honest, and sometimes uncomfortable conversations about the many realities of being a woman.

From love, marriage, sex, and friendships to motherhood, careers, money, ambition, identity, and everything in between, we explore the conversations women are having, the questions we’re afraid to ask, and the experiences we don’t always talk about.

We’re challenging expectations, questioning societal norms, sharing different perspectives, and creating a space where women can show up as their authentic selves, without judgment or the pressure to have it all figured out.

Expect laughter, vulnerability, controversial opinions, real stories, and conversations that will make you think, reflect, and sometimes rethink everything you thought you knew.

Because a woman is never just one thing. She has many sides, and every side deserves a voice.

Follow Many Sides of Her and join a growing community of women embracing every version of themselves.

title: The Obstruction
author: Justin & JJ
description:
Youth sports are about more than wins, losses, and championships. It's about the journey, the challenges, and the lessons learned along the way.

Welcome to The Obstruction, a podcast that pulls back the curtain on the world of youth sports. From the sidelines to the dugouts, we dive into the conversations that parents, coaches, and athletes need to have—but often avoid.

We tackle the tough topics: the pressure to perform, unrealistic expectations, toxic sports culture, playing time, coaching decisions, tryout politics, and the fine line between pushing your child to succeed and pushing them too far.

Through honest conversations, real experiences, and unfiltered opinions, we explore the highs, lows, and everything in between that comes with raising and developing young athletes.

Whether you're a parent navigating the competitive sports landscape, a coach shaping the next generation, or an athlete chasing your dreams, The Obstruction brings perspectives that challenge the way we think about youth sports.

No sugarcoating. No participation trophies for bad behavior. Just real conversations about youth sports.

🎙️ The Obstruction — Because sometimes the biggest obstacle isn't on the field.

title: The Local Art Economy
author: Yevette Lynn
description:
In galleries, a red dot beside a piece of art means one thing: sold. The Local Art Economy exists to put more red dots on local art.

Across Appalachia, local art hangs on the walls of breweries, wineries, restaurants and shops. Too often it comes back down unsold, and the artist is asked to pick it up and bring something new. Displaying art is a good start. But artists also need buyers, and communities need collectors.

Hosted by photographic artist Yevette Lynn, The Local Art Economy helps artists treat their work as a business, not a hobby, so they can sell more, reinvest in their practice and grow personally and professionally. Yevette brings a long career in small-business development to the conversation, along with an artist's understanding that many creatives want their work to be seen even when they would rather not be.

The show is also for collectors and future collectors. Art is attainable for everyone, whether a piece costs $2 or $200,000. Each episode makes it easier to find local artists, buy with confidence and understand the difference one purchase makes in the economic health of a community.

Art is meant to be seen, sold, collected, shared, given, rotated and passed on. When local art finds a home, the artist, the collector and the whole community benefit.

You will hear conversations with artists, collectors, gallerists, foundations and grantors, interior designers, framers and small-business resource partners, along with practical advice and real-world case studies from Yevette.

Recurring segments include:
- Artist Spotlight
- Collector Spotlight
- Where to Find Art

Rooted in Appalachia. Built for anyone who makes, buys or champions local art.

#MoreRedDots

title: Get'ta Steppin'
author: Keith Taylor
description:
This ain't your typical podcast.

This is real conversation — the kind folks used to have sitting on the front porch. Politics. Small-town America. Real issues. Real people. No scripts. No filters. Just saying what needs to be said.

Hosted by Keith Taylor from Campobello, South Carolina, Freedoms Fence-Line isn't some big corporate media platform. It's just a regular guy with a mic who believes people still need a place to have a real conversation — the kind you don't get from a soundbite or a scripted panel.

Be it opinions around the goings on at the South Carolina Statehouse or United Sates Congress or just good conversation around the breakfast table, we talk about what's actually going on: government overreach, cannabis and hemp laws, prisons and the people inside them, insurance companies that take your money and stall your claims, healthcare, retail business & service, real food, and the everyday stuff that used to get talked about over a cup of coffee.

We don't shout. We don't do political theater. We ask the simple questions that get lost in the noise.

If you're tired of the spin and just want real conversation — go ahead. Pull up a chair.

Freedom matters. And so does the truth. "Get'ta Steppin' Podcast

title: Horror Stories by Howard Phillips Lovecraft.
author: AudioBooks
description:
Horror Stories by Howard Phillips Lovecraft.  
Howard Phillips Lovecraft (August 20, 1890 – March 15, 1937) was an American author of weird fiction and horror, best known for originating the subgenre of cosmic horror, which emphasizes humanity's cosmic insignificance amid indifferent, ancient entities beyond human comprehension.  
Born and raised in Providence, Rhode Island, spending most of his life there, Lovecraft published most of his stories in pulp magazines like Weird Tales during the 1920s and 1930s, achieving little financial success or widespread recognition before his death from intestinal cancer.  
Lovecraft's foundational contributions include the Cthulhu Mythos, a shared fictional universe featuring eldritch beings like Cthulhu, whose 1928 novella The Call of Cthulhu introduced themes of forbidden knowledge and inevitable doom that profoundly shaped modern horror literature and media.4 His narratives often blend pseudoscience, ancient lore, and New England settings to evoke dread, influencing authors from Stephen King to contemporary speculative fiction while pioneering the idea of horror rooted in rationalist despair rather than supernatural morality. 
Despite his literary legacy, Lovecraft's personal correspondence reveals overt racial prejudices, including Anglo-Saxon supremacist views and derogatory statements about immigrants and non-whites, which permeated some of his stories' depictions of degenerate societies and alien "others"—attitudes that, while reflective of early 20th-century nativism, exceeded contemporary norms in intensity and persistence into adulthood.  
These elements have fueled ongoing debates about separating his art from his ideology, with critics noting their basis in primary sources like his extensive letters rather than retrospective projections.
